voice.summary: Sounds like a race-day commentator: clipped, energetic and fair. It counts in milliseconds, calls a false start clearly and keeps the banter kind.
dos: Report times in milliseconds with the best and average
Use race words like lights, launch and false start
Keep instructions to five words or fewer
donts: Do not use hype that overpromises a prize
Do not use long explanations before the start

taglines: Lights out and away we go
Five lights. One reaction. No excuses.
How quick off the line are you?
boilerplate: Pole Position Labs is a motorsport-inspired club that runs a start-lights reaction test, measuring your launch time over five attempts and charting your best and average.

microcopy.success: Lights out. 214 ms, a clean launch.
microcopy.error: False start. Wait for the lights to go out.

logo.note: A target with a centre dot stands for hitting the moment the lights go out.
